Kraków's consultation on shrinking the SCT to about 1 km² runs 27 Nov–18 Dec and is open to anyone; the fee-freeze consultation closes 27 Nov.
Chrzanów's clinic starts paid lead and cadmium blood tests on 26 Nov after toxins were found in nine Kościelec children; the source is still unknown.
Tatra county threatens to run horse carts to Morskie Oko's Włosienica itself from 1 December, defying the national park and climate ministry.

Tamil Nadu police detained BJP leaders including state chief Nagendran over Thiruparankundram; BJP says the TVK government defied the Supreme Court, while its allies praise it.
West Bengal's BJP government approved renaming the state 'Paschim Banga'; the proposal goes to the Assembly on Dec 9 and then needs Parliament's approval.
ICMR's SAMPADA survey finds 56% of Indian women and 42% of young children anaemic, below NFHS-5 figures, though the methods differ.
ISRO's chief says the first industry-built PSLV will fly in Q1 2027; he gave no date for the uncrewed Gaganyaan G1 flight.

Air fine for now (Krasińskiego, 06:00: PM10 21.5, PM2.5 17.8 µg/m³); calm frosty weekend could worsen it.
Andrzejki nights: extra night buses 26/27 Nov (611 every 20 min) and new night lines 604 and 618 on 27/28 and 29/30 Nov.
A4 Modlniczka junction: night resurfacing Wed–Thu after a daytime closure; detour via Różańskiego/Handlowców.
Main Square Christmas market opens Fri 27 Nov under heavy security (barriers, plainclothes police); ceremony Sat 12:00.

Sikorski publicly questioned a reported Pentagon hold-up of 60 Patriot interceptors for Ukraine; the Pentagon did not confirm it.

rules.name: Housing and Community Development Act of 1980: Verification of Eligible Status (mixed-status families final rule, RIN 2501-AE16)
rules.changes: Ends prorated housing assistance: a household loses aid if any member lacks lawful immigration status, and tenants must prove eligible status.
rules.affects: Mixed-status families in public housing and voucher programmes (HUD estimates about 20,000 households, advocates say about 78,000 people), plus housing agencies and landlords.

rules.name: Act of 22 Oct 2026 amending the PIT, CIT and lump-sum tax acts (tax reliefs)
rules.changes: Abolishes the internet-cost relief (up to 760 zł/yr) and the business-expansion relief (up to 1m zł/yr); doubles the deduction limit for donations to blood-donor causes; extends the robotisation relief by 10 years.
rules.affects: Taxpayers claiming the internet relief, firms using the expansion and robotisation reliefs, donors.

deepDive.title: Three health counts, three measuring problems
deepDive.body:
**Analysis.** Three health stories this week turn on how a number is measured, not just on how big it is.

In the US, CDC's measles count reached 5,838 confirmed cases as of Nov 19, the most since 1991 and more than double last year's total. Pennsylvania (ninth death) and Wisconsin (third) reported new deaths on Tuesday. Yet CDC lists only six deaths nationwide, without naming states. Reuters links the gap to a switch to NCHS death-certificate data under Secretary Kennedy. That data runs weeks behind state health departments. Until the federal tally catches up, state releases are the better guide ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/24/pennsylvania-reports-ninth-measles-death-in-ongoing-state-outbreak)).

In India, ICMR's SAMPADA survey found anaemia in 56% of women of reproductive age and 42% of young children. Both figures sit below NFHS-5, which put children at 67%. But SAMPADA tested venous blood on lab analysers, while NFHS used finger-prick tests and different age bands. ThePrint warns that the gap does not prove anaemia is falling. What the survey does show is that iron deficiency explains only about half the cases, which matters for policy built on iron tablets ([ThePrint](https://theprint.in/health/anaemia-incidence-lower-finds-icmr-survey-but-over-half-of-indias-women-still-affected/3107564/)).

Near Kraków, Chrzanów's clinic starts paid lead and cadmium blood tests on Thursday. Toxins were found in nine children from the Kościelec estate. Inspectors found no clear source: tap water was normal and the soil has not yet been tested. The clinic's head says neither Kraków nor Katowice has an NFZ-funded children's toxicology clinic for follow-up ([Radio Kraków](https://radiokrakow.pl/wiadomosci/chrzanow/w-chrzanowie-bedzie-mozna-zbadac-krew-na-obecnosc-olowiu-i-kadmu-przychodnia-odpowiada-na-obawy-mieszkancow/188147)).

**Science note:** ISRO says the first PSLV built by the HAL–L&T consortium should fly in Q1 2027, a test of whether private industry can take over the workhorse rocket. It gave no date for Gaganyaan's uncrewed G1 flight.
